lines: Phase 2's machine gate is green on the final build: all 15 checks (G1 to G12, G14, D2, D3).

The blockout film is rendered: 1800 frames on five VMs in about 9 minutes, joined with the blockout mix (only the kept cues sound) and kept as out/preview-b.mp4. The render budget was measured again on this scene.

Round 2: the cameras and screens scored 8 with two major issues and none severe (the opening camera cuts the foot of the tree at the bottom edge; on the phone the sound control sits on the reflection's outline). Both are carried. The film sheets are still being judged.
The globe can be shaken now at the app link: stand-in shapes, live shake, four seasons, published 08:16.
A push to the repo failed at 08:24: the sign-in for git is missing in this workspace since then. Commits are kept locally and the push is tried again at every commit.
phase 2: 5.43 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 6.61 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The whole blockout film in 12 frames, every shot at least once (stand-in shapes)
The opening: from the close camera with no edge of the glass, pulling back to the whole globe; the reveal is marked at 3.00 s
One sheet across shake 1, winter into spring: the camera is locked, only the globe moves
The close: one push from the whole globe back to the opening's camera, so the last frame meets the first
